reviews.text: Excellent Training

Amazing experience with GIFMAF! The difference in my pup has been incredible. He’s listening so much better, walking beautifully on leash, and overall seems much more relaxed. The training definitely doesn’t stop when they come home, but GIFMAF gave us the foundation, structure, and tools to continue working with him every day. So grateful for everything they taught both him and us. Highly recommend! 🐾❤️

An incredible transformation for Clarita and complete peace of mind for us!

We took advantage of our two-week vacation to leave our dog Clarita in the training program at Gifmaf Dog Psychology Center in Homestead, and we couldn't have made a better decision.

Before going, Clarita was extremely difficult: she barked every time we had guest, suffered from anxiety, and got super nervous every time we left the house. Leaving her at the academy gave us total peace of mind while we were away, but the best part was coming back: the transformation was simply amazing!

Clarita is now so much calmer and well-balanced. She obeys the commands they taught us to use with her. Walking outside with her is now a pleasure.

We are beyond impressed with the results and feeling so much happier. We want to give a special thanks to Erika, who was super helpful and answered every single one of our questions, and to the owner, Giann Carlos—a true professional who genuinely loves dogs and changes the lives and behaviors of so many pets.

We 100% recommend Gifmaf Dog Psychology Center. Thank you so much for everything!

Best training!! My dog would bark at any guest or sound inside or around our house. She was reactive and very wary after getting attacked by another dog but the trainers here did such an amazing job and gave us all the tools to enforce all her training at home.
100% recommend🙌🏼🙌🏼

We had such an amazing experience with GIFMAF Dog Psychology Center! From the very beginning, everyone was so kind, professional, and genuinely caring with Melo 🐶🤎

Melo completed his training program with them, and we were so happy with the progress we saw. He came home more focused, better behaved, and with skills that we can continue building on at home. I appreciate that they took the time to work with him as an individual and helped us understand how to continue his training beyond the program.

You can rly tell that they care about the dogs and aren’t just doing a job… they genuinely want to see them succeed 🥹🐾

We’re so excited to continue working with them and keep watching Melo grow. I would absolutely recommend GIFMAF to anyone looking for a trainer who is knowledgeable, patient, and truly invested in their dog’s well being.

Thank you for taking such great care of our baby Melo! 🤎🐶✨

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐

Our experience with GIF MAF has been incredible! We've seen a super positive change in our dog, Chabelita, and we're thrilled with the results. They're always available to answer our questions and support us throughout the entire process.

Chabelita's training was a complete success, and the follow-up class was excellent and super productive. What we value most is the peace of mind that comes from knowing all the dogs in their care are well-balanced and have either completed training or are currently undergoing it. That gives us so much peace of mind.

We can travel with complete peace of mind, leaving Chabelita with them and knowing she's in good hands, that everything will be fine and under control. That peace of mind is priceless. 🥹🐶❤️

For us, they're the best. There's no better place to entrust your dogs than GIF MAF. We recommend them 100%.

GIFMAF Dog training 100 out of 100. No doubt. Best Dog trainers in DADE COUNTY.. I really appreciate all the good work. You guys done with Pluto and Piper. No doubt I will leave an awesome review again. GIFMAF Dog Trainer. Best in the world. Thank you guys for everything with Pluto and Piper. And I really appreciate the great and awesome work that you guys provided to them the structure that you guys have taught them. The discipline. I can go on and on. But you guys are very good. And God bless you guys. Thank you again.
Amazing and so skillful!

We had such a great experience with Sky’s training! The team was amazing, caring, professional, and always kept us updated throughout the entire process. We could really see how much time and attention they put into working with him, and the progress he made was incredible. They also took the time to teach us everything we need to continue practicing with him at home. We’re so happy we chose them and will definitely be back for group training and future stays. Thank you so much for taking such good care of Sky! ❤️🐶 Highly recommend!

GIFMAF is the real deal! they’re super hands on with your dog, and get right to business right away. my 11 month old puppy hadn’t been in any sort of training before, and right from day 1 he learned so many commands! they are also super friendly and interactive, and update you on your fur baby every day. i will continue to use and board them for the future! 10/10
Thank you so much!!!

I don’t even know where to begin.
From the very start the team has been nothing short of amazing.
They are so professional, but so kind and reassuring that I really had no doubts that they were the right place for my pup.
Coop needed help with his confidence and general manners and obedience. He spent 12 days at his training, and while we are still a work in progress, he is light years ahead from where he was before.
I received daily videos from Giann with the progress. Erika answered all and any of my questions or concerns throughout the whole process.
And the best part? Our training doesn’t stop just yet. We just attended our first group class and I cannot stop raving about it. Can’t wait for many more to come.
Look at my once timid boy (the smallest pup in the picture) sitting so calmly with his new puppy friends.
This team truly cares, and it shows. ❤️

This 30-day board and train program exceeded all of my expectations! My 1 year-old poodle has completely transformed. He now walks confidently with and without a leash, no longer pulls, is much more disciplined, and stays calm in public. Going out with him used to be stressful, but now our walks are enjoyable and peaceful. The best part is that he still has the same sweet, energetic personality—he just has more structure now. The communication from GIFMAF was amazing from day one, with daily updates, photos, and videos. It was worth every penny. Highly recommend if you’re looking for the best dog trainers in Miami! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

★★★★★

We sent our Miniature Poodle BooBoo to Gifmaf for the 30-day board & train and got back a completely different dog — calm, settled, no more jumping, walks properly on the leash and doesn't stop for other dogs. Full off-leash obedience: come, sit, down, place, heel, off, stay. He even respects the rooms we asked to keep him out of.
Giann Manuel is the most impressive trainer we have ever dealt with — polite, calm and completely in command. And it doesn't stop with the dog: he gave us 90 minutes at pickup, then came to our home for another 90 minutes tailored to our rooms and our street. Erika was wonderful throughout.
Everything they say on their website, they do. The money is extremely well spent.
A deeply sincere and heartfelt thank you to Giann Manuel and to Erika — you have changed our daily life with BooBoo, and we are genuinely grateful.

We couldn’t be happier with our experience! Our 1.5-year-old Goldendoodle, Rocky, spent 30 days at Gifmaf for boarding and training, and the results exceeded our expectations. We are so proud of everything he learned and how much he has improved.

Gian, Erika, and the entire team always kept us updated on his progress and took the time to answer all of our questions. As first-time dog owners, their guidance, ongoing support, and monthly group classes have given us so much confidence. We now feel much more comfortable handling Rocky and know we have an amazing team we can always turn to whenever we need guidance.

We are truly grateful for their dedication and commitment. We highly recommend Gifmaf to anyone looking for a trustworthy and professional boarding and training program. Thank you for taking such great care of Rocky

We had an amazing experience with Gifmaf's! Jade completed the 10-day boarding and training program with Giann Manuel, and the transformation was incredible. She went in as a very hyper, overly excited puppy, and came home calm, obedient, and much more focused.

She learned commands like sit, stay, place, and no longer jumps on people. We were especially impressed with how calm she remained around distractions.

Giann also took the time at pickup to walk us through all of Jade's commands and let us practice with her, so we felt confident continuing her training at home.

We highly recommend Giann Manuel and the Gifmaf Miami team to anyone looking for outstanding dog training. Thank you for everything!

Just wow!! Great job 💯👏🏻 my baby nikko is now a fluffy boy who knows how to control his emotions and feels more independent.
Thank you so much guys! …
Amazing training! My beautiful dog learned so much with them. They were always in contact with me and shared lots of photos. They are very professional and I highly recommend them.

We had a great experience with GIFMAF Board & Train. Everyone was knowledgeable, easy to work with, and genuinely cared about making sure both we and our dog were set up for success.

One thing we really appreciated was that the support didn’t stop after the program ended. They recently did a follow-up session to check in, answer questions, and help us fine-tune a few things. It was great to know they were still invested in how everything was going.

Overall, we’re really happy with the experience and would definitely recommend GIFMAF to anyone looking for a board and train program. Thanks again for everything!
My Aussie had a great experience! Gian and the team are super experienced and he came back super calm and well behaved.
Excellent work, patient and very caring in their teaching style, I recommend them 100%.

We sent our rescue pitbull to their 10-day boarding and training program to help her with her nervousness and reactivity (mostly with bigger dogs). We had trained our dog to have a basic baseline understanding of commands, which she did decently well, but we were struggling to resolve the aforementioned issues.

In only a matter of 10 days, our dog came back completely different - much more calm and much more able to self-regulate emotions in what she usually saw as a stressful situation. Further, our dog was much more focused on us during our walks and less focused on her surrounding environment - something she had a hard time doing before. Manuel and his team did a wonderful job. They have the expertise to break bad habits and build on top of any foundation already established with your dog. Highly recommend.

My dog did the one month board and train due to her nervous and anxious nature while in public. It was hard for me to even get simple obedience from her. But the trainers are GifMaf have absolutely astounded me with how well trained my dog is now. They left her with amazing structure that I can now build off of.

We brought Winnie to GifMaf along with another family dog, at first sending her off to training wasn’t even in our minds. She was doing good with potty already and we didn’t think anything else was important. Once we started seeing her reactiveness with other dogs and we reached out to GIFMAF Erika and Gian Manuel guided us through the process and explained the value in implementing structure into Winnie’s life. We chose the two weeks board and train and they would update us daily and send us videos. After what felt like the longest two weeks, pick up day came, where Gian Manuel spent 2 hours of his undivided attention to teach and guide us in the process of taking Winnie home while maintaining structure and setting her up for success.
Today Winnie follows all of her commands and maintains structure, keeping her safe. We appreciate GIF MAF for everything they did for us and Winnie

Highly recommend the trainers! We have already seen such a positive change in Winnie since starting training. They were patient, knowledgeable, and truly took the time to understand her personality and needs. It’s amazing to see her progress and the confidence she’s gained. We’re so happy with the results and grateful for the care and dedication they’ve put into helping her grow!🥰

I don’t even know where to start but GIFMAF literally changed my family’s life. I adopted my giant baby on a whim and genuinely thought that there would come a point where it was going to be either the dog or me. He was so so poorly structured. I adopted him at the age of 1 after he was dumped at the shelter and passed from shelter to rescue. He came into my life: reactive, scared, and unconfident. He broke my nose, scratched my face and body, and broke countless items around my home. People in my life everywhere would tell me to just let him go and send him back to the shelter. I knew if I managed to save enough I’d be able to give him a shot that no one else would. I found GIFMAF and sent Topo away for a 30 day board and train and I can safely say the dog I got was a totally new dog. He is so confident and calm. He understands the structure he was given and lives off of high alert for the first time in who knows how long. GIFMAF not only helped my family, they helped give this angel a second chance at a life worth living. Although we must keep reinforcing the structure and training he came with from the program, it’s a small price to pay for a life of calm and peace. Thank you one million times over for the AMAZING GIFMAF team 🤍
Excellent service! I am grateful and happy with the results for my dog ​​Tequila; she is now a calmer, less reactive dog.

My experience with GIFMAF has been wonderful. My biggest fear about sending Almita, my Golden Retriever, to a dog training school was not knowing how she would be treated. Thankfully, that was never an issue.

Seeing Giann Manuel in person showed me how much he genuinely loves animals. He would pet her, teach her, and work with her using incredible patience and kindness. I was truly impressed.

Another thing I loved was the follow-up session. He took the time to explain in detail how to continue the structure and training at home. After the walk, he placed Almita on “place,” and she peacefully fell asleep. He then went over and gently petted her, and that moment really touched me.

I love people who are genuinely kind to animals because it says so much about who they are as people🥰🐶 I truly admire Giann Manuel’s patience, dedication, and love for every dog he works with. I highly recommend GIFMAF to anyone looking for a trainer who cares deeply about both dogs and their owners

My 5-year-old Weimaraner had the opportunity to do the 12-day training course with Giann Manuel, and the changes were remarkable. She stayed there, and they took care of her during that time, sending me videos of her progress. One of the things I like most is that they have distractions to practice with, like birds, llamas, robots, etc. They practice "place," which is important, as is walking beside you. There's also a group practice you can attend once a month to maintain training and make corrections. I highly recommend this place, gifmaf, for enjoying obedient training with your dog.
